overview_description.description: Prodigy Finance is an online platform that offers community loans to international postgraduate students.  Prodigy Finance also provides a mobile app through which users can manage and access their loan information seamlessly. The platform specifically helps fund master's degree students in 18 countries, aiming to make education accessible to those who might not have other financing options.

product.name: International Student Loans
product.description: Education loans for eligible international students pursuing supported master’s programs abroad, with financing based partly on future earning potential and no required collateral or co-signer.

product.name: Education Loan Calculator
product.description: An online tool that estimates monthly repayments, total interest, fees, and total repayment for a potential Prodigy Finance education loan.

product.name: Study-Abroad Finance Guidance and Resources
product.description: Educational content and support for students planning international master’s study, covering financing, applications, visas, schools, careers, and repayment planning.

product.name: Scholarship Information and Guidance
product.description: Scholarship-related information and educational guidance for students seeking additional funding for international master’s study.
